headline: Small and clean at dawn, fading by afternoon — Saturday's the one to circle.
today: A little SSE bump around 1.1-1.4ft on a prime angle, cleanest with the NW cross-off dawn and light morning before SW cross-on sneaks in. Fun-size longboard peelers if you happen to be out east, but not worth the 2.5hr from home. Save the drive.

daysToWatch.note: The pick of the week for a drive: 1.7-2.2ft on a prime SSE angle, NE cross-off in the morning going glassy light by afternoon. Clean and rideable — worth the trip.
Biggest at 2.6-3ft prime angle but short period and SSW cross-on all day. Punchy and messy — surfable if you're already out there, not a target.
